action.details: Uses an allowlisted bundle-ID-to-shortcut table for Preview, Skim, Evernote, PDF Expert, Obsidian, GoodLinks, Scrivener, Pages, Logseq, DEVONthink, Alternote, iA Writer, iA Presenter, PDFpen, and Apple Notes. Unsupported apps fail without sending a shortcut.
action.exampleOutput: ActionClip sends Preview's Control-Command-H highlight shortcut.
action.name: Highlight
action.privacySummary: ActionClip sends a reviewed keyboard shortcut to the active supported app. The selected text does not leave your Mac.
action.requirements: The selection must remain active in one of the supported apps. Accessibility permission is required to target the source app.
action.summary: Apply the active app's known highlight command.
